acceptItems.text: Every shipped filter traces to Spark metadata; registry/metadata disagreement fails the build.
acceptItems.reason: ci:search-registry-generated + field-registry. 131 exposed fields. URL contract is FilterSchema.

acceptItems.text: No zero-match filter; no confidential field; find-a-filter matches values; class-aware facets.
acceptItems.reason: ci:search-field-completeness + find-a-filter value match + class-prevalence. Confidential keys stay off the public surface.

acceptItems.text: Zoning as jurisdiction:code with definitions and verification dates; permits-intents only.
acceptItems.reason: lib/zoning/resolve.ts keys jurisdiction:code. Find-a-filter renders plain English when unambiguous. STR is never inferred from zoning (R-019).

acceptItems.text: Every long-tail searchable concept is exposed or excluded with a §10 reason.
acceptItems.reason: This ledger: 268 concepts (222 custom + 46 standard), zero unexplained.

acceptItems.text: Sold search carries the same filter depth as active, behind a registered VOW gate.
acceptItems.reason: VOW chokepoint is live (ODS §5-4: audience must be vow). Sold browse stays on the legacy RPC, not searchListingsAll. Same-depth sold search is the residual — do not lift VOW data onto a public index.

acceptItems.text: Drawn shapes: multi-shape include/exclude, URL-persisted, server-evaluated; drawn geography reaches alerts.
acceptItems.reason: MapSearchView + ?shapes= + search_listing_keys_in_shapes. G4 enrolls the same filters into listing_alerts.

acceptItems.text: Named saved areas reusable in searches and alerts.
acceptItems.reason: search_areas + AreaPicker + /account/areas. Public broker-authored areas at /areas/[slug].

acceptItems.text: Filter paint <800ms p75; pan pins <500–800ms; cold TTFB <600ms; timeout honesty.
acceptItems.reason: p75 recorded on this file under perf. Structural timeouts stay locked by ci:search-perf-budget.

acceptItems.text: Search chrome: omnibox, chips, Save/Alerts, count/sort, map+list lockstep; sentence search writes the same params.
acceptItems.reason: WAVE3 shipped. R-105 already VERIFIED. Sentence search writes FilterSchema params.

acceptItems.text: Account portal unifies alerts, saved searches, saved homes, named areas, activity.
acceptItems.reason: /account renders those rails from live queries. /dashboard redirects to /account.

acceptItems.text: All 22 sub types selectable with live counts; no substring match on property_sub_type.
acceptItems.reason: propertySubTypes is an enumerated multi over the 22 feed values. DAL is IN, not ILIKE.
